label: Every origin edge between distinct beings is realized by its source's productive exercise
paraphrase: Difference statement: for every CAUSE_4 origin edge CausesOrigin c x, either c = x or an occurring exercise a borne by c produces x's existence (produces as in DEF-NO-EXISTENTIAL-SELF-PRODUCTION). Classically this is the universal origin-to-exercise bridge restricted to edges whose source and target are distinct; the disjunctive form avoids assuming decidable identity. It carries the coming-to-be-to-being step for ordinary origination of one thing by another and says nothing about self-origin edges.
